summary: @servicetitan/carto-react-kit preinstall executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun runtime
details: package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary (bun-v1.3.13) for the installer's platform from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, chmods it executable, and then execFileSyncs the shipped math_init.js under that Bun binary. math_init.js is a ~727 KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle with obfuscator.io-style string-array plus rotator obfuscation (rotator function WV8StW over a large constant array n7gIxM), opaque to Node-based inspection and not referenced by the package's own dist/index.js. The package advertises itself as a React UI component kit and has no functional need for a second runtime or an obfuscated compiled blob at install time. The `@servicetitan/` scope combined with devDependencies on an internal-looking `@carto-internal/*` scope pinned to unpublished 0.0.0 stubs is consistent with impersonation of an internal enterprise package. Installing the package runs the obfuscated Bun payload with the installer's privileges on every install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
